paragraphs: A servant of R' Yehudah Nesia. He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, Beitzah, chapter 1, halakhah 9, where R' Zeira asked him a question.[^1]

notes.text: The saved Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:9 paragraph has רבי זעורה asking קלה דרומה, the servant of רבי יודן נשייא. Hyman writes קלא and abbreviates the names as ר״י נשייא and ר״ז. The English retains the inherited Yehudah and Zeira renderings with R', rather than silently substituting the digital name forms or assigning authority identities. The supplied קלא and the digital קלה remain distinct spellings. The servant relationship and direction of questioning have local digital support. No legal teaching or additional figures from the paragraph are imported. This is digital text evidence, not printed lettering or correction history; earlier English and model judgments remain archived.
